steps.title: Define requirements for Smart Notes
steps.description: Establish application parameters including category filtering, search interface, SQLite database schema, and custom dialog editors.

steps.title: Initialize Project Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Configure standard AndroidManifest.xml with launch Activity, permissions, package declaration, and native material styles.

steps.title: Configure app/build.gradle properties
steps.description: Inject native compile SDK 34 specifications, min SDK 21 target, Java 17 toolchain, and build system rules for compilation.

steps.title: Build Background Tab Drawables
steps.description: Define round-cornered background layouts for active and inactive category navigation buttons inside drawable resources.

steps.title: Build Card & Badge Drawables
steps.description: Set up custom XML design sheets for note list entries (borders and backgrounds) and category badges in drawable resource path.

steps.title: Construct MainActivity Layout Structure
steps.description: Create main-screen layout featuring a live filter search edit bar, horizontal tag categories scroller, and dynamic item ListView feed.

steps.title: Establish Notes Database Helper Class
steps.description: Compose Android's standard SQLiteOpenHelper wrapper to implement high-speed queries, table builders, inserts, edits, and deletions.

steps.title: Construct Data Layer Structure
steps.description: Write high-level getter and setter variables inside Note.java object class for seamless internal state persistence.

steps.title: Design List Row XML template
steps.description: Build layout components matching requirements for displaying category tags, formatted timestamp headers, title layouts, and text preview.

steps.title: Design Notes Dialog Editor XML
steps.description: Produce a modular layout incorporating multiline fields and selection dropdown spinners for editing category mappings.

steps.title: Develop BaseAdapter Logic implementation
steps.description: Create dynamic NoteAdapter.java to bind native SQLite models securely into UI custom template layout files.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Controller Methods
steps.description: Wire up tab switches, dynamic live-text search listeners, note creator interfaces, database updates, and alert controllers.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Compile sources and generate intermediate binary outputs using standard automation build commands.
